evidence.summary: Admin bypass keys on user['role'] == Role.ADMIN, the same source require_roles trusts (session mode: app_user.role via normalize_role); no new trust input. Non-admin grant rows of '*' or holding a comma are now ignored, closing a widen-to-all path. Non-numeric forged/worker identities still unset. API restarted live: /health 200, unauthenticated /api/v1/auth/me 401 locally, via web proxy and via the public tunnel.

rationale: Change narrows non-admin scope inputs and grants admins exactly what D-0056 accepts. Stub mode (local/pytest) was never a product-line boundary since a missing header already meant admin. Open: PUT product-lines should reject '*'/comma with 400.
